claim_boundary: R4 closes the planning solar model by explicitly bracketing unresolved off-site geometry. It does not convert approximate photo-supported angular envelopes or 10/12/14 m gum estimates into surveyed geometry, and it does not authorize ordering/fabrication.

fov_merge_policy.biological_merge: Overlapping gum/other-foliage evidence is merged to a single biological occupancy union. Porous attenuation is applied once per ray, using the scenario open-sky fraction; repeated photos or overlapping biological groups never multiply attenuation.
fov_merge_policy.provenance: Each envelope lists all supporting photo filenames so duplicate fields of view remain traceable without double-counting.
fov_merge_policy.structural_merge: Within a named structural obstruction, overlapping photo evidence is merged to one skyline envelope per azimuth; it is never stacked. Across distinct opaque structures, the highest skyline at an azimuth controls because any opaque obstruction blocks the ray.
fov_merge_policy.structural_precedence: Opaque structural blockage is evaluated before biological porosity and dominates it.

metrics.deterministic_dappled_pattern_hours: Per 0.25 h sample, deterministic shared-seed binary dapple mask within occupied biological envelope. Same random field is reused across scenarios; lower open-sky fractions are nested subsets.
metrics.expected_open_sky_weighted_hours: Per 0.25 h sample, counts 0 for opaque blockage, scenario open-sky fraction for an occupied merged biological envelope, otherwise 1. This is the primary low-noise planning metric.
